fact: The World Bank GEQIP-E status report (updated 24 April 2024) records the indicator on piloting and scaling EMIS digital data collection as in progress on 18 Apr 2024, with the pilot in secondary schools and national rollout to all primary and secondary schools retargeted to 2023/24.
title: Ethiopia General Education Quality Improvement Program for Equity (P163050) Implementation Status and Results Report
